needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right sidewalk is partly blocked by objects and uneven surfaces
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and level the uneven sections of the sidewalk on the right side to ensure it is fully usable.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the right sidewalk that pose trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out the uneven sections of the right sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The marked crossing is hard to see and drivers may not stop
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island and enhance the visibility of the crossing with better markings and signage to ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access and improve crossing visibility.
